names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Φωτεινός ο Επίσκοπος, Σάνκτιος ο διάκονος, Βέτιος, Επάγαθος, Ποντικός, Βιβλίδης, Άτταλος, Αλέξανδρος, Μάτουρος και οι συν αυτώ Μάρτυρες», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 24 апреля ст. ст., name page 14895, «Александр Лионский, мч.», with the rank abbreviation after the comma left off; the day’s own line gives the genitive «Александра Лионского». Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'александр лионскии' has no other holder in the corpus, where the bare «Александр» has many.

death.note: saint.gr's head line for him reads «(; - 177)», and the entry says the company was perfected in martyrdom in 177 under the emperor Marcus Aurelius (161-180). The page gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 апреля ст. ст. — «Мч. Александра Лионского (ок. 177).»
source.note: The day’s second entry, and THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line carries a link to his name and none to a reading, and the name page behind it, 14895, prints the title «Александр Лионский, мч.» and «День памяти: 24 апреля» and nothing else. The year, «ок. 177», is the 177 this folder already holds off saint.gr and `dates` was not changed. REPORTED, NOT ACTED ON: the same calendar’s 22 апреля ст. ст. prints «Мч. Епиподия Лионского (ок. 177).» in exactly this shape, a martyr of Lyons of about the same year with a name page and no life, and that line became the folder `epipodius-of-lyons` in this same branch. In the Latin tradition the two are a pair martyred together. NEITHER PAGE NAMES THE OTHER, so no `related` row was written in either direction and no company was read; it is an author question and it is stated as one. Not checked: azbyka.ru.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Φωτεινός ο Επίσκοπος, Σάνκτιος ο διάκονος, Βέτιος, Επάγαθος, Ποντικός, Βιβλίδης, Άτταλος, Αλέξανδρος, Μάτουρος και οι συν αυτώ Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and it does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. One page carries all nine, each with a head line of its own and the year «(; - 177)», and above them a heading for the unnamed companions; the enumeration is why there are nine folders here and not one. Lyons in Gaul is named as the place of the martyrdom and `locations` is left out all the same, because the corpus does not place a martyr on the strength of one clause in a one-sentence entry. No hymn is printed for any of them. Of Alexander the page says nothing but his name, his rank of martyr and the year. The heading above his head line is a lexicon entry on the name and its bearers, from Alexander of Macedon downwards, and it is the page's own furniture and not a word about this man.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
